inlines.v: WAGON, noun 1. A vehicle moved on four wheels, and usually drawn by horses; used for the transportation of heavy commodities. In America, light wagons are used for the conveyance of families, and for carrying light commodities to market, particulary a very light kind drawn by one horse. 2. A chariot. [Not in use.] WAGON, verb transitive To transport in a wagon Goods are wagoned from London to the interior. WAGON, verb intransitive To practice the transportation of goods in a wagon The man wagons between Philadelphia and Pittsburg.
